description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - Regulations on accounting of Financial Administration of MC/UC/PS
categorisation: This gazette primarily contains regulatory provisions for the financial administration of Municipal Councils, including accounting standards, financial management procedures, and compliance requirements. It establishes a legal framework for municipal financial operations under the Provincial Council (Incidental Provisions) Act and Municipal Council Ordinance, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5). While it mentions the Governor (Mahipala Herath) in the notification, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather uses his authority to enact these financial regulations.
